about.title: About {Me}
about.subtitle: 2nd Year {IT student}
about.text: I am a christian, I love to sing, dance, and play instrument for the glory of God. I am someone who believes that growth begins with the willingness to learn. I may not know everything, but I am always curious, open to new experiences, and willing to improve myself. I enjoy exploring my creativity through technology, web development, and design, where I can turn my ideas into something meaningful. I believe that every challenge teaches me a lesson, every mistake gives me a chance to grow, and every small achievement is worth appreciating. I value humility, hard work, and the support of the people who help me along the way. I may still be discovering what I am capable of, but I am determined to keep learning, moving forward, and becoming a better version of myself. After all, I believe that being someone worth remembering is not about being perfect or knowing everything, but about having the courage to grow, the humility to learn, and the heart to remain true to who I am.

research.title: ACCEPTABILITY OF MUSAPARADISIACA BLOSSOM AS A PLANT-BASED BURGER PATTY ALTERNATIVES
research.text: This study examines the acceptability of Musa paradisiaca blossoms as a plant-based alternative to meat patties. Thirty participants evaluated the patties based on appearance, texture, aroma, and taste. Results showed that the patties were generally accepted, especially in appearance and texture, while aroma received a moderate rating. The findings suggest that banana blossoms have potential as a sustainable alternative to meat-based patties.

research.title: THE IMPACT OF COLLABORATIVE LEARNING STRATEGIES ON THE ACADEMIC PERFORMANCE AMONG THE STUDENTS OF GRADE 11 STEM STRAND OF DEBORAH AT KCP-BAMBANG INC.
research.text: This quantitative study examined how collaborative learning affects the academic performance of 25 Grade 11 STEM students at Kings College of the Philippines–Bambang. Survey results showed that group activities helped students understand STEM concepts, solve problems, communicate, respect different ideas, and develop leadership skills. The study concludes that collaborative learning supports both academic achievement and personal development.

research.title: NEGATIBONG EPEKTO NG SOCIAL MEDIA SA AKADEMIKONG PAGGANAP NG MGA MAG-AARAL NG IKALABIN-ISANG BAITANG MULA SA ABM MARALACHI NG KCP.BAMBANG INC.
research.text:
Layunin ng pananaliksik na alamin kung paano nakakaapekto ang social media sa pag-aaral ng mga mag-aaral at kung paano ito mapapamahalaan. Gumamit ito ng quantitative method at Descriptive Survey Design sa 24 na mag-aaral na may edad 16 hanggang 18 sa King's College of the Philippines Laboratory High School-Bambang.
Lumabas na higit na negatibo ang epekto ng social media, dahil nababad at naaaliw ang mga mag-aaral dito, na humahantong sa katamaran, pagbabago sa ugali, at mga isyu sa pagtulog. Mahalaga ang balanse sa paggamit nito at sa iskedyul ng pag-aaral.
